notes_for_editor: The platform's history is absent: no source gives a build date, design, staffing, or fire record, and the Wikipedia article has no lookout history. The FFLA lists the platform as removed with no date, and no source places it on the summit in text. Access and visitor facts come from Wikipedia, which may lag on road, railway and facility status, so check the Pikes Peak Highway and Cog Railway before publishing. Two web searches turned up only unrelated Devil's Head pages. The brief's agency value is confirmed by Forest Lookouts and Wikipedia. The Wikipedia visitor figure (over 600,000 a year) was a 2018-era plan for the older facility to stay open during construction, so it was dropped rather than presented as current.
